title: South Congress & 78704 Lifestyle Living
excerpt: The 78704 and South Congress corridor continues to attract buyers who want restaurants, music, and walkability.
body:
People searching Austin-area real estate for “homes near South Congress Austin”, “78704 houses for sale”, and “SoCo neighborhood real estate” want a local, practical answer.

The 78704 and South Congress corridor continues to attract buyers who want restaurants, music, and walkability.

Single-family inventory is constrained; many options are smaller footprints, updated bungalows, or townhomes. Prices reflect the lifestyle premium.

Traffic, parking, and weekend energy are part of the package.

Buyers who prioritize quiet will look a few streets farther from the main corridors.

Sellers in this pocket benefit from strong photography that captures both the home and the neighborhood vibe.
